trading_rules: 1. Avoid Freak Wicks (09:15 - 09:20 AM): Never enter on the opening spike. Wait for the 9:20 AM candle to establish Clean PDH levels.
2. Wait for 5-Min Candle Close: Breakout must be confirmed with a solid candle body close above Clean PDH, not just a wick piercing.
3. 3-Stage Confirmation: Breakout (Stage 1) -> Pullback Retest (Stage 2) -> Green Reversal Entry (Stage 3).
4. Risk Management: Always fix Stop Loss immediately. Maintain at least 1:2 Risk-to-Reward ratio.
5. Sector Alignment: Long entries work with 80%+ higher success rate when the stock's sector index is Bullish.
